strings.사정은 어느 정도 들었습니다. 공주님은 회복되는 대로 아오이치로 모시겠습: I've heard the broad outline of what happened. I'll take the princess back to Aoich once she has recovered.
strings.많이 혼란스러운 것 같군요. 당신이 하는 일, 제가 뭐라 말씀드리긴 어렵: You seem deeply troubled. I'm afraid I can't tell you what to make of the path you're on.
strings.이제 어떻게 하실 건가요? 원래 하시던 일이 있지 않았나요?: What will you do now? Didn't you have something you were originally pursuing?
strings.아, 이리스 님…. 이리스 님께서 지금 어디 계신지는 알 수 없지만, 어: Ah, Lady Iris... I can't tell you where she is now, but I can tell you where she went.
Up? The ceiling? Oh, the sky.
strings.이곳에서 동료들과 식사를 하면서 이야기했던 게 생각나는군요. 저 하늘에: I remember her discussing it while dining here with her companions. They said that if they went up into the sky and met the Aesir, they might learn something...
strings.의지로 가득했던 분들이었죠. 이곳에서 사이암이라는 분을 만났던 것도 기억: They were full of determination. I also remember them meeting someone named Siam here.
strings.미드가르드를 비롯한 지엔디아에 과학을 전파해 준 분들이에요. 미드가르드: They brought science to Jiendia, including Midgard. Some of Midgard's residents are descended from the Aesir themselves.
strings.정확히는 잘 모르겠지만, 비프로스트 제일 위로 올라가 보세요. 그곳에 아: I'm not certain, but try going to the very top of Bifrost. I hear there's a machine there that can take you into space, where the Aesir live.
Oh, then I'll go right away. Thank you for telling me.
You're welcome. At least have something to eat before... Already gone.
...Somehow, I feel that adventurer may find Lady Iris before long...
strings.(비프로스트 안쪽으로 들어가자 거대한 우주선이 보인다.): (As you make your way inside Bifrost, an enormous spacecraft comes into view.)
strings.와아, 진짜 이런 게 있었네. 이것만 타면 아스가르드로 갈 수 있는 건가: Wow, it really exists. Can I get to Asgard just by boarding that?
strings.(어디선가 인기척이 느껴진다. 어떤 소녀가 %s의 모습을 보더니 짐짓 놀: (You sense someone nearby. A girl spots %s and recoils with an exaggerated look of surprise.)
strings.헛, 이런 곳에 사람이라니…. 지점장인 저 스큐라! 정말 믿을 수 없어요: Oh! A person, in a place like this...! I, Branch Manager Scylla, simply cannot believe it!
strings.아, 아스가르드 행 우주선을 타러 오셨나요?: Oh, have you come to take the spacecraft to Asgard?
strings.네, 맞아요. 그런데 진짜 갈 수 있어요?: Yes. But can it really take me there?
strings.물론이죠, 손님!! 이곳에 오게 된 이후로 16795%%시간 32분 33: Of course, dear customer! At last, after 16795%% hours, 32 minutes, and 33 seconds since arriving here, we can finally leave!
strings.(신경이 엄청나게 쓰이는데….): (How am I supposed to ignore that...?)
strings.아스가르드 행 셔틀이 곧 출발합니다! 승객 여러분께서는 신속히 탑승해주시: The shuttle to Asgard will depart shortly! All passengers, please board immediately!
strings.스큐라가 친절히 안내할게요!: Scylla will be happy to show you the way!
strings.어, 저를 왜 그렇게 보세요? 문어 다리 우주인 처음 보세요?: Oh, why are you looking at me like that? Never seen an alien with octopus legs before?
strings.문어 다리 우주인은 처음이긴 하지만, 제가 스큐라를 본 건 스큐라가 기뻐: It is my first time seeing an alien with octopus legs, but I was looking because you seemed so happy, Scylla.
strings.이상한 괴물도 보고, 불꽃으로 뒤덮인 새도 보고, 용도 보고 그랬으면서: You've seen strange monsters, a bird covered in flames, and even dragons. Surely a girl with octopus legs isn't that surprising?
strings.그런데 제가 그런 존재들을 만난 건 어떻게 아시는 거죠??: But how do you know I've met those beings?
strings.아하하…. 스페이스 셔틀 출발합니다! 손님, 목적지까지 편안하게 가시기: Ahaha... The space shuttle is departing! Dear passenger, enjoy a comfortable journey to your destination. That's all from Scylla!
strings.(셔틀 안에 조심히 가라는 스큐라의 안내 멘트가 울려 퍼진다. 이어 움직: (Scylla's announcement wishing you a safe journey echoes through the shuttle. Once it stops, the doors open with a resounding noise.)
It looks like a small spacecraft attached to an enormous one...
strings.내가 좀 닮긴 했지만, 스큐라는 아니오! 스큐라라면 비프로스트 정거장에: I may bear a resemblance, but I am not Scylla! Do you mean the beautiful, innocent young lady at Bifrost Station?
strings.그렇다면 사람을 착각했소!: Then you have the wrong person!
strings.앞으로 굴러서 봐도, 뒤로 굴러서 봐도 스큐라인데요?: You look like Scylla no matter which way I turn.
strings.엣헴! 어딜 봐서! 그런 큐티하고 러블리한 소녀에게 엄숙하고 근사한 수염: Ahem! In what way?! A cute, lovely young girl like her could hardly have a magnificent, dignified mustache like this!
strings.하긴, 본인이라면 우주선보다 더 빨리 우주를 건너 여기에 왔다는 게 되니: Besides, if you were her, you would have crossed space faster than the spacecraft to get here.
strings.엣헴, 아무것도 아니오! 이건 모두 당신의 착각이오! 후후, 그러면 아스: Ahem! Nothing! It's all your imagination! Hehe. Well, I hope your business in Asgard goes well.
Getting here was so exhausting that I think I need a rest.
strings.네, 그럼 쉬세요. 그런데 여기 어디로 가야 다른 사람을 만날 수 있나요: All right, rest well. But where should I go to meet someone else?
strings.길을 찾아 안쪽으로 가면 이슈타르 라는 분을 만날 수 있소!: Follow the path farther inside, and you will meet someone named Ishtar!
Thank you. I'll be going, then.
strings.아! 가시면서 고장난 메카들을 파괴하면서 가는 게 수월할 거예요. 아니,: Oh! It'll be easier if you destroy the broken mechs along the way. I mean, it shall be easier!
strings.(스큐라? …로 보이는 존재가 %s의 대답을 회피한 채 뒤로 물러나 손을: (The being who looks like Scylla...? avoids answering %s, stepping back and waving.)
You seem to be saying something... What was that? Just go and see?
...Whew. No choice, then. Shall I go find this Ishtar...?
strings.(많은 메카 뒤로 어딘가로 향하는 통로가 보인다.): (Beyond a crowd of mechs, you see a passage leading somewhere.)
That must be it. But what's that sound...? This is...
strings.(끼릭끼릭. 기계가 돌아가는 소리가 머무는 곳은 바닥이다. 바닥에 파괴된: (Click, whirr. The mechanical noise comes from the floor, where pieces of a seemingly destroyed machine lie scattered.)
strings.아, 이건 여기서 봤던 메카의 잔해잖아. 방금 여기서 전투라도 일어난 건: Oh, these are remains of the mechs I saw here. Was there a battle just now...? I can smell something like scorched shells.
And there are signs of a fight with monsters...
Who is there? I don't recognize that voice...
strings.(안쪽에서 특이한 방어구를 장착한 여성의 모습이 보인다. 잠시 후, 여성: (Farther inside, you see a woman wearing unusual armor. A moment later, she approaches, hovering with its support.)
strings.멈춰. 조금이라도 수상한 짓을 하면 먼지로 만들어주겠어. 사라스바티, 왜: Stop. Make one suspicious move and I'll turn you to dust. Sarasvati, what is it?
strings.(여성의 옆으로 사라스바티라 이름불린 누군가의 모습이 희미하게 홀로그램처: (Beside the woman, someone called Sarasvati appears faintly, like a hologram.)
strings.이슈타르 언니, 잠시 기다리세요. 그 사람은 지상인이 아닙니다. 시스템이: Ishtar, wait a moment. That person isn't a surface dweller. The system is in confusion. It may be the same as last time.
strings.너는 누구지? 누군데, 왜 여기서 오류를 일으켜. 존재 자체가 의심스럽군: Who are you? Who are you to cause errors here? Your very existence is suspicious.
strings.사이암이라고 하셨나요? 이리스의 동료인?: Did you say Siam? Iris's companion?
strings.너도 아는 건가? 이리스…. 오랜만에 듣는 이름이군. 그래, 넌 왜 이곳: You know him too? Iris... That's a name I haven't heard in a while. So, why are you here?
strings.(이슈타르에게 이리스의 행방을 찾고자 여기까지 오게 됐다고 간단하게 설명: (You briefly explain to Ishtar that you came here to find out where Iris went.)
So you're the anomaly Sarasvati noticed a little while ago.
strings.인식되지 않았던 존재가 인식됐던 건 분명 이상합니다만, 지금은 시스템이: It is certainly strange that an unrecognized presence has become recognizable. However, the system now recommends that we trust this person...
An adventurer searching for Iris... No, perhaps Iris called you herself...
Even if we explained, you wouldn't understand it right away.
strings.사라스바티 말대로 할게. 너 이름이 뭐지?: I'll do as you suggest, Sarasvati. You—what's your name?
strings.좋아. 우리 아스가르드 방위군은 <조력자>로서 당신을 환영한다. 나는 이: Good. We, the Asgard Defense Force, welcome you as an <ally>. I am Ishtar, commander of Asgard's defensive line.
You may call me Miss Ishtar.
strings.네, 이슈타르 씨. 반가워요. 그런데 조력자요?: Yes, Miss Ishtar. It's a pleasure. But an ally?
I ask for your cooperation, even if only briefly. In return, you should be able to reach what you're seeking.
strings.그렇게 할게요. 그러면 뭘 하면 될까요?: I'll help. What should I do?
strings.지금 이곳은 알 수 없는 곳에서 온 존재들 때문에 복잡해. 그래서 그걸: Beings from an unknown place are causing trouble here. I've been investigating, and your arrival has brought about a slight change.
strings.정확히 뭐라고 해야 할지 모르겠지만, 하여튼 그래. 지금 나는 이 주위의: I can't say exactly what it is, but that's how things stand. Right now, I need to examine the systems around here.
strings.그래서 너에게 부탁을 하고 싶어. 왔던 길로 돌아가 다시 한 번 살펴봐: So I'd like to ask you a favor. Would you retrace your steps and take another look along the way?
strings.(저 멀리, 멈춰있는 메카가 보인다. 메카는 인기척을 느꼈는지 힘겹게 가: (In the distance, you see a motionless mech. As though sensing your approach, it struggles to start up.)
strings.(부서져 있으니 괜찮은 것 같은데…. 폭주한 종류와는 다른 느낌이야….): (It's broken, so it may be safe... It feels different from the ones that went berserk...)
Neither a being of Asgard nor a monster from another world...
strings.마치 사이암 님과 같은…. 치직…. 당신은 누구 십니까?: Similar to Lord Siam... Kzzzt... Who are you?
strings.(날 인식하고 있어? 아, 혹시 이슈타르가 보고 오라고 했던 게….): (It recognizes me? Oh, is this what Ishtar wanted me to check...?)
You mean Lady Iris, who came with Lord Siam. Kzzzt...
Creating temporary account. Registering target account provisionally under [Ally]... I am identification number SB7-37, a Belt-type Angel. Please call me [Elmay]. Kzzzt...
strings.엘메이, 반가워요. 저는 %s…, 엘메이는 지금 괜찮은 건가요?: It's nice to meet you, Elmay. I'm %s... Are you all right?
strings.치직…. 오랜 전투 끝에 한계가 다가왔습니다. 치직…. 프로토타입이라 지: Kzzzt... After prolonged combat, I am approaching my limits. Kzzzt... As a prototype, in my current condition I could cease functioning at any time...
strings.이슈타르 님은 괜찮으신가요? 치직…. 언제부턴가 어디서 나타났는지도 모를: Is Lady Ishtar all right? Kzzzt... At some point, monsters began appearing from an unknown source... I fought against their attacks, which were certainly no coincidence, but...
Miss Ishtar is all right. Oh, Elmay. I'll take you to her.
strings.치직…. 제 중량은 %s 님의 세배 정도…. 무리는 하지 마시기 바랍니다: Kzzzt... My weight is approximately three times yours, %s... Please do not overexert yourself...
strings.제가 도울 수 있는 일이 있을까요?: Is there anything I can do to help?
strings.치직…. 역시 그분들과 같은 친절한 사람… 그러면 이슈타르 님께 말씀드려: Kzzzt... Kind, just like those people... Then could you ask Lady Ishtar for an AI Booster and bring it to me?
strings.제 보존 기능을 일정 기간 연장해주는 장비입니다. 그게 있으면 코어 유닛: It is equipment that extends my preservation functions for a limited period. With it, I can eject my core unit. Lady Ishtar could then repair me. Kzzzt...
strings.치직…. %s 님의 얼굴에서 이리스 님이 겹쳐 보입니다…. 동료였던 사이: Kzzzt... I see Lady Iris's face in yours, %s... I also recall her companion, Lord Siam...
strings.아, 무리하지 말고 있어요. 빨리 다녀올게요!: Please, don't push yourself. I'll be right back!
If I... recover... As they once stood beside me... I too will... for you...
strings.엘메이! 다행이다. 아직 살아있었구나. 다행이다. 많은 전투를 함께 한: Elmay! Thank goodness. Still alive... What a relief. A veteran of so many battles at my side...
strings.벌써 시간이 그렇게 지났네…. 2년 전 사건 때문에 우리는 오천 번 정도: Has it already been that long...? Because of that incident, we went from maintaining about five thousand Belts to producing twenty thousand.
strings.여기를 지켜야 하거든. 그렇지 않으면 여길 넘어 지엔디아도 위험해질지 몰: We have to protect this place. Otherwise, the danger could spread beyond it, even to Jiendia...
strings.엘메이는 초기 모델, 그것도 37번이지. 아, 맞다. 엘메이가 필요한 게: Elmay is an early model—number 37, in fact. Oh, right. You said Elmay needed something?
strings.(이슈타르가 듣자마자 AI 부스터로 보이는 물건을 손에 쥐여준다.): (The moment Ishtar hears this, she places something that looks like an AI Booster in your hand.)
strings.그 아이에게 꼭 전해줘. 어머니의 엔젤이었던 엘메이는 어머니와 함께 내가: Please make sure it reaches Elmay. Elmay was my mother's Angel. Both Mother and I were very fond of that one. So special that we gave Elmay a name ourselves.
Like... a sister. I want so much to see Elmay again...
Now that I know how much Elmay means to you, I'll hurry. I'll be right back.
Kzzzt... Time has run out. There was an error of approximately 147 seconds...
How unfortunate. This is strange. Ah... This should not be a system error.
This state that I sense within my system...
Would humans call it fear? Or sadness...?
strings.이것이 인간이 말하는 감정이라는 걸까요?: Is this what humans call emotion?
strings.%s님, 다시 만날 수 없어 유감입니다. 고맙…다는 말씀을 드려야 했는데: %s, I regret that we will not meet again. I should have... thanked you...
strings.치직…. 불가능하겠지만, 선대 마스터셨던…. 이슈타르님의 부모님을 만나고: Kzzzt... Though it is impossible, I wish to see my former masters... Lady Ishtar's parents...
strings.치직…. 만나서 이슈타르 님께서 멋지게 성장하셨다고…. 치직…. 두 분께: Kzzzt... I would tell them how splendidly Lady Ishtar has grown... Kzzzt... Make them proud...
strings.(엘메이의 움직임이 멈춰있다. 힘겹게 마스터를 그리워하던 느낌의 음성마저: (Elmay is motionless. Even the strained voice that seemed to long for former masters has fallen silent.)
I want to know. About Iris, and about this place...
strings.(엘메이의 앞에 작은 칩이 떨어져 있다.): (A small chip lies in front of Elmay.)
I don't know what it is. I'll take it to Miss Ishtar... Elmay...
strings.수고 많았어, %s. 그런데 표정이 왜 그래?: Thank you, %s. But why that expression?
strings.(이슈타르에게 엘메이가 가동을 멈췄다고 이야기한다. 그리고 엘메이의 근처: (You tell Ishtar that Elmay has stopped functioning, then hand over the chip you found nearby.)
strings.(이슈타르가 충격을 받은 표정으로 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Ishtar looks so shaken that she cannot speak.)
strings.미안해, 그리고 고마워…. 엘메이의 잔해는 내가 나중에 이 일이 끝나는: I'm sorry. And thank you... Once this is over, I'll go and retrieve Elmay's remains myself.
strings.…지금 이런 상황이 너무 싫네. 슬퍼할 여력조차 없다니…. 계속해서 나타: ...I hate this situation. There's not even time to grieve... I have to keep defeating the monsters that appear and repair the broken mechs.
Sarasvati is looking for the cause, but I don't know how long it will take.
strings.이슈타르 씨? 저는 이제 뭘 할까요?: Miss Ishtar? What should I do now?
Sorry, give me a moment. I have a message to send.
(Ishtar begins speaking, apparently sending a message somewhere.)
Freya... Is everything all right there? Everything's fine? There's just a slight problem...?
strings.이상한 소리하지 말고. 이상 없냐고 물었잖아. 그걸 왜 지금 말해? 타이: Stop talking nonsense. I asked whether everything was all right. Why are you only telling me now? Even if the timing was awkward...
strings.사라스바티와 프레이아가 하고 싶은 이야기가 있다고 하니까 가보겠어? 가는: Sarasvati and Freya say they have something to tell you. Would you go see them? While you're on the way, could you also deal with the farm mechs rampaging in the Hydroponic Farm...?
I can do that right away.
strings.프레이아의 성격이 유별나서 오래 붙잡고 있을지 모르니 적당히 끊어줘. 미: Freya can be a handful, and she may keep you talking for ages. Feel free to cut her off. Sorry.
What Sarasvati wants to tell me...
It's probably about the one you're searching for...
strings.(수경농장 쪽에서 엄청나게 큰 폭발음이 들려온다.): (An enormous explosion rings out from the direction of the Hydroponic Farm.)
Oh, I'd better hurry. I'll hear the rest from Sarasvati herself.
strings.(수경농장을 넘어서 들어온 또 다른 공간, 장난기 어린 표정의 소녀가 인: (Beyond the Hydroponic Farm, you enter another chamber. A playful-looking girl is dancing, apparently unaware of your arrival.)
strings.쟝쟈가쟈가쟈가, 장쟈가쟈가쟈가! 으음, 사람? 꺄핫, 사람이다♡: Jang-jagga-jagga-jagga, jang-jagga-jagga-jagga! Hmm, a person? Ehehe, a person! ♡
strings.사람이다! 사람! 이슈타르 언니 말고 사람이라니!: A person! A person! Someone besides Ishtar!
strings.혹시 당신이 프레이아?: Are you Freya, by any chance?
strings.(소녀가 갑자기 차렷 자세로 경례를 한다.): (The girl suddenly snaps to attention and salutes.)
strings.멀뚱멀뚱 계시지 말고 경례 받아주세용!: Don't just stand there staring—return my salute, please!
strings.받아드리면 되는 건가요?: You want me to salute back?
strings.(얼떨결에 경례를 받는 %s의 반응에 프레이아가 만족한 표정을 짓는다.): (Freya looks satisfied as %s awkwardly returns the salute.)
strings.우주에 뜬 콜로니! 여긴 누가 오니?! 콜로니 한구석에 정신적 케어 추구: A colony floating in space—who's visiting this place?! In one little corner, we tend to the soul! Keep planting lettuce, however hard the toll! ♬
strings.콜로니의 아이돌 프레이아! 비련의 여전사 프레이아! 숨겨진 상냥함 가득이: Freya, the colony's idol! Freya, the lovelorn warrior! Hidden kindness shining bright—even lifeless mechs fall for me outright! ♬
strings.이슈타르 언니를 넘어선 메인!! 바로 프레이아! 아, 이건 실언♥: The leading lady, surpassing Ishtar—Freya herself! Ah, that slipped out. ♥
strings.프레이아 님, 방금 뭐라고 하셨…: Lady Freya, what did you just say...?
strings.아이돌, 상냥, 비련, 홀딱 반한다구요?: An idol? Kind? Lovelorn? Mechs falling for you?
strings.(프레이아가 세상 빛나는 미소로 커돌이를 바라본다.): (Freya turns the most radiant smile in the world on Kerberus.)
Keep walking, quietly. Or I'll pull out your memory chip.
strings.아, 넵. 저는 그냥 지나가는 커돌이!: Ah, yes! Just a Kerberus passing through!
I dealt with the mechs that were rampaging in the Hydroponic Farm.
strings.우힛, 고마워요. 당근 드실래요?: Ehehe, thank you! Want a carrot?
Ugh, a black carrot? A purple carrot...? N-no, I'm fine.
strings.당근에 뭘 넣은 건가요?: What did you put in that carrot?
strings.데헷, 하여튼 당근은 안 드신다니 어쩔 수 없죠. 부탁드릴 일이 있답니다: Tehe! Well, if you won't eat the carrot, I suppose it can't be helped. I have a favor to ask! ☆ Some strange creatures have appeared on the way to Sarasvati's room.
strings.다른 세계의 신인 로키가 왜 나타났는지 모르겠지만, 여기서 장난을 치고: I don't know why Loki, a god from another world, is here, but he's causing mischief.
strings.일단 잡아주세요. 로키가 가지고 있는 물건을 얻으면 사라스바티가 원인을: Please catch him first. If you obtain what he's carrying, Sarasvati can determine the cause.
Then you should be able to find the answer you're looking for.
Nyahaha! Have a carrot before you go. It'll give you strength.
If you don't have any red carrots, I'll pass. See you later, Freya.
Come in, Kerberus. Kerberus, Kerberus, this is Freya.
strings.넵, 저는 다시 돌아온 커돌이. 프레이아 님, 무슨 일이시죠?: Yes! Kerberus reporting back. Lady Freya, what is it?
strings.커돌아, 커돌아? 빨간 당근 본 적 있어?: Kerberus, dear Kerberus... Have you ever seen a red carrot?
strings.(디-라보의 제일 끝인 공간, 새로운 격실 중심에 홀로그램 형태의 스크린: (At the far end of D-Lab, in the center of another compartment, a girl is looking at a holographic screen.)
You've arrived. I've been waiting. Please stay there for a moment.
Opening the Hyperspace Network... H-E-L-L-O. Welcome.
Yes, you know me well. About what you said earlier, about surface dwellers...
The spacetime network has been following your accomplishments with great interest.
There may be more to it than you imagine.
In that sense, I am the <Hyperspace Network> itself...
strings.인간으로서 태어난 것은 분명합니다만…. 저희 일족은, 육체를 버리고 전자: I was certainly born human... But our people declared that we would abandon our bodies and make the electronic galaxy our domain.
Humans who believed our human bodies no longer held meaning...
strings.어렵네요. 지엔디아의 여러곳과는 역시 다르고, 아틀란티스의 과학력이 봉인: That's hard to understand. This really is different from the rest of Jiendia. I can see why Atlantis's technology was sealed away...
Indeed. The hasty spread of technology brought many tragedies.
strings.%s 님께선 이리스 님을 찾아 오셨다고 했지요. 그러면 이리스 님에 대해: You said you came looking for Lady Iris, %s. Then, regarding her...
strings.일단 구하신 걸 저에게 주시겠습니까?: First, could you give me what you obtained?
Only someone like Lady Iris could obtain this item.
strings.죄송하지만, 거기까진 말씀드릴 수 없습니다. 시스템에서 허락한 범위가 아: I'm sorry, but I cannot tell you that. It is outside the permissions granted by the system. Opening a new protocol...
strings.(사라스바티의 손에 있던 로키의 물건들이 스크린에 흡수되듯 빨려 들어간다: (Loki's belongings in Sarasvati's hand are drawn into the screen, as though absorbed.)
strings.잠깐…. 이건 뭐지? %s 님, 혹시 디-라보에서 로키 말고 다른 것을: Wait... What is this? %s, did you see anything besides Loki in D-Lab?
There were some strange children running around.
So the unusual dimensional energy manifested in that form after all.
strings.%s 님, 저희가 있는 공간에 순수한 인간은 %s 님과 이슈타르 언니뿐입: %s, the only fully human people in this place are you, %s, and my sister Ishtar.
They are probably humans from another dimension's Jiendia, or another dimension's Asgard. The only person who can meet and speak with them now...
You followed Lady Iris all the way here. You are more than capable.
I would like you to meet them. You may not understand one another's language...
strings.정신공감기…라고 하는 걸 가지고 그들에게 가시면 됩니다. 그건 디 -라보: Take a device called a Mind Communicator to them. The beings in D-Lab should have one.
strings.그들이 만나줄까요?: Will they agree to meet me?
If you can communicate, it should be all right.
Afterward, I will tell you what I intended to say.
All right. If I'm the only one who can do it, I'll try.
strings.(이야기할 수 있는 존재인 소년과 소녀가 다가오는 %s의 모습을 보고 경: (The boy and girl you can speak with grow wary as %s approaches.)
strings.저 사람, 싸울 의사가 없어 보여. 내 말이 맞지?: That person doesn't seem to want a fight. Am I right?
I think I can understand them better as I get closer... I'll give them the Mind Communicator. Here, this... In my hand... Here...
strings.(소년이 %s의 행동을 바라보다가 고개를 끄덕인다. %s의 손에 있던 정: (The boy watches %s's gestures and nods. The instant the Mind Communicator passes from %s's hand to his, your mind seems to clear.)
Oh, I can hear you. I understand you.
strings.아… 말이 통한다!: Ah... We can understand each other!
It's true! I can hear you! Amazing! It must be a translator.
I'm %s. I'd like to talk with you.
strings.역시 저 사람은 도플갱어가 아니었어!: I knew that person wasn't a doppelganger!
strings.아, 이럴 때가 아니지. 제 소개를 할게요. 저는 루비!: Oh, no time for that. Let me introduce myself. I'm Ruby!
strings.그럼 무슨 이야기를 할까요? 맛있는 디저트?: So, what shall we talk about? Delicious desserts?
strings.루비, 그게 아닌 것 같아. %s…, 하고 싶은 이야기가 뭐야?: Ruby, I don't think that's it. %s... What did you want to talk about?
strings.너희들도 이리스를 찾아 여기 온 거지?: You came here looking for Iris too, right?
strings.이리스가 누구지? 알아, 루비?: Who's Iris? Do you know, Ruby?
Sorry, I've never heard that name.
strings.이리스를 몰라? 2년 전 마왕을 물리친 데르족의 소녀…. 나는 그런 이리: You don't know Iris? The Tyr girl who defeated the Demon King two years ago... I came here looking for her. Didn't you?
I don't think there was anyone like that in Lin's party...
strings.분명 서리의 성 대공녀 트리스타, 주술사 사티, 해룡왕 아휼, 아가슈라: There was Grand Duchess Trista of the Frost Castle, Sati the shaman, Ahyul the Sea Dragon King, Owen the Agasura Hunter, and Lin the Dragon Knight! That's everyone.
Even children in the capital, [Parangis], know that story.
strings.수도인 파랑기스를 몰라?: You don't know Parangis, the capital?
This conversation has been strange from the start.
strings.아까 사라 언니랑 한 이야기로 미루어 짐작 가는 게 있어. 자, 일단 내: Based on what Sara told us earlier, I have an idea. First, let me tell you about us.
strings.어느 날, 우린 꿈을 꿨어. '오웬'이라는 사람이 마왕과 싸우는 꿈이었지: One day, we had a dream. A person named Owen was fighting the Demon King.
strings.마왕은 물리칠 수 있었지만, 그때까지 일행의 리더였던 린 언니가 심한 상: They defeated the Demon King, but Lin, who had led the party until then, was badly wounded and captured by an Agasura.
strings.다른 일행들도 아가슈라에게 당할 위기에 처했었는데… 바로 그때! 어머나: The others were about to fall to the Agasura too... But then! Can you believe it? The Demon King used the last of his strength to save everyone except Lin!
In truth, the Demon King had come to share Lin's feelings...
strings.마왕이 소멸해 빛과 어둠의 균형이 깨지면서 세계가 멸망할 위기에 처하자: When the Demon King vanished, the balance of light and darkness broke, putting the world in danger of destruction. They say that's why we were summoned.
strings.린 언니를 구하고 지엔디아를 구하기 위해서 벨로스 마을에서 수많은 모험가: I still clearly remember beginning our adventure in Belos Village, alongside countless other adventurers, to save Lin and Jiendia!
strings.(벨로스… 뭔가 내가 아는 벨로스가 맞는 것 같으면서 아니네….): (Belos... It sounds like the Belos I know, yet somehow it doesn't...)
strings.이거 다들 아는 이야기인데…. %s, 당신은 모르는 거야?: Everyone knows this story... You don't, %s?
I'm not sure. Then... This is confusing.
strings.응, 역시 그거야. 사라 언니가 말했던 대로…: Yes, that must be it. Just as Sara said...
strings.우리가 서로 다른 세계의 사람이라 이야기하고 싶은 거지?: You mean we're people from different worlds, right?
strings.마왕, 아가슈라는 알겠지만, 벨로스 마을부터 이야기하는 게 달라서 말이야: I know about the Demon King and the Agasura, but your story is different right from Belos Village. I've never heard of any of the people Ruby mentioned.
strings.너희들 한 번만 더 확인할게. 이리스, 카즈노, 무웬, 조에, 엘리아스…: Let me ask once more. Have you ever heard of Iris, Kazno, Muwen, Zoe, or Elias...?
No, I still don't recognize them...
strings.사라스바티 언니가 이야기한 것처럼, 평행세계가 서로 겹친 것 같아. 서로: As Sarasvati said, it seems parallel worlds are overlapping. Perhaps we're speaking through copies of <Unknowns> in different worlds whose frequencies are similar.
strings.아…, 사라스바티는 거기에도 있나 보구나. 나도 지금 너희들에겐 언노운…: Ah... So Sarasvati exists there too. I suppose I must look like an Unknown to you as well.
Kai, don't be like that. Try to understand.
strings.하여튼 아가슈라를 물리치기 위해 여행하는 거라지? 너는 그 이리스라는 여: Anyway, you're traveling to defeat an Agasura, right? And you're here for that girl Iris.
strings.그래, 맞아. 나는 이리스를 찾아…. 어?: Yes, that's right. I'm looking for Iris... Huh?
strings.%s 님, 응답… 부탁드립니다. 들리십니까? 그 앞에 다른 세계의 존재가: %s, please... respond. Can you hear me? If beings from another world are with you, please do not tell them that I have contacted you.
strings.어서 돌아와 주십시오. 현재 계신 곳의 차원안정도가 급격히 낮아지고 있습: Please return immediately. Dimensional stability at your location is dropping rapidly.
You could fall into a gap between time and space. This is extremely dangerous. Please leave at once.
Sorry, I think I need to go. This place...
strings.우리도 그 정도 눈치는 있어. 우리들도 이동해야 할 것 같은데… 헤어지려: We can tell that much. It looks like we should move too... But I hate to say goodbye.
Then take care, both of you... I hope we can meet again someday.
strings.(인사와 함께 루비와 카이의 모습이 언노운이라는 모습에서 천진난만한 소년: (As they say farewell, Ruby and Kai change from the forms of Unknowns into an innocent-looking boy and girl, then disappear.)
Were those... their real appearances? In their world...?
I'd better hurry back to Sarasvati. Maybe I'll understand when I get there. What is this place...?
strings.(묘한 공기가 가득한 격실 안, 사라스바티가 스크린 안에 움직이는 문자들: (In the strangely charged air of the compartment, Sarasvati concentrates on the characters moving across her screen.)
strings.사라스바티, 저 왔어요. 이제 괜찮은 건가요?: Sarasvati, I'm back. Is everything all right now?
strings.일단은 괜찮습니다. 그리고 그들과의 귀중한 대화 기록을 구해주셔서 감사합: For the moment, yes. And thank you for obtaining that valuable record of your conversation with them.
strings.이 세계의 그림자와 같은 것인지, 아니면 우리와 동등한 위치에 서 있는: Is it something like a shadow of this world, or another world standing on equal footing with ours...?
I cannot say for certain, but this is the first time we have obtained such direct evidence.
strings.네. 정말 묘한 기분이었어요. 내가 몰랐던 또 다른 세계와 그곳에서 사는: Yes. It felt very strange. Speaking with people who live in another world I never knew existed...
There is something else I need to tell you. About the doorway just ahead.
strings.현재 디-라보와 위그드라실 사이를 잇는 곳에 이차원에서 흘러들어온 강력한: At the passage connecting D-Lab and Yggdrasil, a powerful being from another dimension is blocking the entrance.
strings.그 강력한 힘은 이 세계 자체를 변질시켜버릴 정도입니다. 현재로서는 레코: Its power is strong enough to alter this world itself. For now, Record and Query are holding it back between them...
...We will need to keep watching the situation for the moment.
strings.시간을 지체할 수 없어요. 현재 차원의 상태는 너무나 불안정합니다. 로키: We cannot afford to delay. The dimension is extremely unstable because of the world Loki came from...
strings.저희 세계의 시공안정 상태가 불량하면 주변의 세계와 우리 세계의 충돌을: If our world's spacetime stability deteriorates, it could cause a collision between our world and the worlds around it.
...I cannot say. What is certain is that we must do something before it happens.
That is why we need to restore Yggdrasil's facilities to normal.
strings.%s 님, 헬즈도어에 있는 지옥의 여신, [헬]을 물리치고 해당 지역을: %s, please defeat [Hel], the goddess of the underworld at Hell's Door, and restore the area to normal.
Then perhaps... you may learn the answer you seek, %s.
strings.(알 수 없는 불길한 기운이 가득한 공간, 마치 지옥이라는 느낌이 어울리: (In a place filled with an unknown, ominous power—a place aptly called hell—an unusual-looking woman waits for her guest.)
This place is like hell. That woman must be...
So the raven's child has come all the way here.
I think you've mistaken me for someone else...
You wish to protect that loathsome city of the gods. But I will not allow it.
strings.나뭇가지에 맞아 죽었을 그대가 어찌 살아있는가!!: You should have died, struck by a branch! How are you still alive?!
strings.빛의 아들이여. 운명을 거역하고 내게 맞서겠다면, 지금 이 손으로 내 영: Son of light, if you defy fate and stand against me, I will make you a subject of my realm with my own hands!
strings.세계와 신들의 마지막 황혼이 시작된다…!!: The final twilight of the world and its gods begins...!
strings.엄청난 공포야…. 하지만, 난 할 수 있어. 답을 얻어야 해. 그러니까: Such terrifying power... But I can do this. I need answers. That's why I have to face you, even if nothing about this makes sense...
strings.(%s의 공격으로 헬의 움직임이 멈춘다. 더불어 불길한 기운으로 가득 찼: (%s's attacks bring Hel to a halt. The ominous energy filling the area seems to recede with her.)
Huh? What happened? My head feels clear.
Thanks to you, I can think clearly again. Thank you.
strings.(헬이 다가와 %s의 볼에 키스한다.): (Hel approaches and kisses %s on the cheek.)
strings.으아아아, 까, 짝이야. 갑자기 이러시면 노, 놀라잖아요!: Waaah! Y-you startled me! You can't just do that out of nowhere!
You aren't used to such things, are you? Hehe.
strings.(지옥의 여신 같은 느낌이었던 여성은 어느새 그런 것과는 상관없다는 것처: (The woman who seemed every inch a goddess of hell now smiles brightly, as though she has nothing to do with such a place.)
strings.고마워요. 제 소개가 늦었네요. …저는 헬, 로키의 삼남매중 막내, 모든: Thank you. I should have introduced myself sooner... I am Hel, the youngest of Loki's three children, the goddess destined to bring all things to an end.
strings.갑자기 차원의 문이 열리면서 이 곳에 오게 되었을 때, 시공의 틈새에서: When a dimensional doorway suddenly opened and brought me here, I seem to have been possessed by a <spacetime worm> in the gap between worlds.
I'm sorry. I wasn't in my right mind for a while.
strings.그럼 지금의 싸움은 본의가 아니었다는 건가요?: Then you didn't mean to fight just now?
strings.네, 저는 원래 세계에서 '신들의 황혼' 시기가 오면 모든 것에 멸망을: Correct. In my own world, when the Twilight of the Gods comes, I am to proclaim the destruction of all things...
strings.새로운 재생의 시간에 새로 태어나는 인류를 인도할 사명을 지닌 여신이에요: And guide the new humanity born in the age of renewal. That is my mission as a goddess. I do not act in places unrelated to it.
strings.형제들과 저의 아버지인 로키, 그분도 마찬가지. 그래서 당신을 봐주셨는지: The same is true of my siblings and our father, Loki. Perhaps that is why he went easy on you.
strings.후후, <기만자> 로키는 그래 봬도 최고신의 형제. 운명이 그를 때려눕히: Hehe. Deceiver though Loki may be, he is the supreme god's brother. Until fate brings him down, no one can truly challenge him.
Though that, too, is a tale from our own world.
In any case, I'm glad you're all right now.
strings.후후, 고마워요. 그럼 용감한 젊은이여, 당신의 길을 계속 떠나세요. 저: Hehe, thank you. Now, brave young one, continue on your path. I shall wait until the dimension stabilizes, then return home.
I'll take my troublesome father and siblings with me, so don't worry.
strings.신격 존재가 하등한 벌레에 사로잡힌 부끄러움을 풀어주셔서 도리어 감사할: I am the one who should thank you for freeing a divine being from the shame of possession by a lowly worm.
I'm glad you're a good person.
We shall meet again, brave traveler.
strings.아무리 혼란스러웠어도 저승의 여왕인 내가 평범한 인간과 빛의 적자를 착각: Confused though I was, how could I, queen of the underworld, mistake an ordinary human for the trueborn son of light...?
strings.후후, 저 여행자가 이 세계에서 맡은 역할을 조금은 알 수 있을 것 같군: Hehe. I think I understand a little of the role that traveler has in this world...
strings.(마치 시간이 멈춘 것 같이 느껴지는 장소, 들어서자마자 알 수 없는 이: (You enter a place where time seems to have stopped, and immediately feel an unfamiliar dissonance. Two strange young men draw your attention, barring the way.)
Stop, stop! Better not come in.
strings.저는 레코드, 이쪽은 동생인 쿼리…: I am Record. This is my younger brother, Query...
We're the administrators of Yggdrasil. Though we're temporarily closed for business.
The ones Sarasvati mentioned... Oh, I'm %s.
So you're the one she told us about. Welcome to Yggdrasil.
strings.에이, 이 정도는 괜찮잖아. 흐음, 무슨 이야기를 할까? 덕분에 살았으니: Oh, come on, this is fine. Hmm, what shall we talk about? You saved us, so I'll hear anything you have to say. As long as it isn't a confession of love!
strings.이리스를 만나고 싶어요. 이리스를…. 아, 이리스라는 사람을 아시나요?: I want to meet Iris. Iris... Oh, do you know someone called Iris?
I see. So you're the adventurer who appeared in answer to Iris's call.
First time I've seen you in person... Hmm, fascinating. How interesting.
strings.뭘 재밌어하는 겁니까, 쿼리. 어떻게 해야 정신을 차릴래요?: What is so interesting, Query? What will it take to make you behave?
strings.저기 두 분…. 분명 사라스바티가 여기에 오면 제가 원하는 답을 얻을 수: Um, you two... Sarasvati said I could find the answer I wanted if I came here...
strings.네, 원하는 답이 될지 모르겠지만 도와드릴 수는 있어요. 이리스 양이 당: Yes. I don't know if it will be the answer you seek, but we can help. The space that Miss Iris reached...
strings.그러면 그 안으로 들어가는 입구를 알려주셨으면 해요. 그곳도 위그드라실인: Then please tell me where its entrance is. Is that place Yggdrasil too? If you could give me permission to pass through...
Ah, sorry about this. It's right here.
You mean this place—the space itself...?
strings.헬 님께서 정신이 돌아올 수 있게 해준 %s 님에게 감사하다며 저희와 협: Lady Hel thanked you for restoring her senses, %s, and agreed to cooperate with us.
strings.별 문제는 없겠습니다만, 이미 침식된 차원을 되돌리는 것은 좀 다른 문제: That should pose no difficulty, but restoring a dimension that has already been invaded is another matter.
If it's beyond your control, it can't be helped.
We are truly sorry... But we can promise you this.
strings.이 장소에 있던 문을 회복시키는 것은, 우리 형제의 명예를 걸고, 전력을: On our honor as brothers, we'll do everything we can to restore the doorway that stood here. So rest easy and wait just a little!
We're the ones who should be thanking you. Hahaha.
Oh? It finished sooner than expected.
The dimension suddenly began stabilizing very quickly. This is...
Should we call you a variable, or something like a virus?
It seems this is all because of you. Thanks to you, I mean.
strings.%s 님, 저 너머의 공간은 과거에 한 번 길이 열렸습니다만…. 그때와: %s, a path to the space beyond opened once before... But we cannot say that it is the same now as it was then.
strings.다시 한번 묻겠습니다. 그래도 가시겠습니까?: Let me ask once more. Do you still wish to go?
There. The doorway is open. Go forward. The answer you've been seeking...
Beyond that dimensional doorway, you'll meet someone who holds the answer.
Thank you. I'll be going, then.
